notes.title: Update Notes for July 11th
notes.content: [p]Fixed the issue where users with Oculus/Meta operated OpenXR would not see their hands / controllers[/p][p][/p][p]Note: If the issue persists, please try to set SteamVR as your OpenXR runtime:[/p][list][*][p][b]Launch SteamVR[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Open the [b]SteamVR menu[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Click on [b]Settings[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]OpenXR[/b] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]"Set SteamVR as OpenXR Runtime"[/b] if it’s not already set.[/p][/*][/list]
